gap_notes: No Layer 2 object: Lilly CA I.16 nature/quality is opened, but schema still requires motivation / strengths / excess / deficiency / behavioral_tendencies which this QUALITY line does not fill without invention.
Element and mode remain two-system: this Lilly QUALITY line is not Ptolemy winds / tropical-vs-equinoctial. Do not collapse into one taxonomy.
Diseases, places, kingdoms, corporature from the same chapter are horary accidentalia — not copied into a sign knowledge object.
Rulership/exaltation identity stays in Foundation §2.5 — not duplicated here as meaning.
Valens I.2 opened: Aries fiery AND watery (weather). Still no Layer 2 object. Do not compare fire with Lilly.

claims.author: William Lilly
claims.locus: Book I Chapter XVI Nature of the twelve signs (1659 p.93–98)
claims.original_claim: Aries is masculine, diurnal, moveable, cardinal and equinoctial; fiery, hot and dry, choleric; bestial, luxurious, intemperate and violent.
claims.normalized_claim: Lilly's Aries is fiery, cardinal, equinoctial, choleric and intemperate
